title: WAICO vs Pax Silica: 2 US-China AI Blocs Ranked [2026]
hook_text: The global AI market just split.
script:
The global AI market just split into two competing power blocs.
WAICO is the new China-led intergovernmental framework for AI development.
Pax Silica acts as the U.S.-led initiative to counter that influence.
Twenty-nine founders are currently driving the strategy behind the WAICO framework.
Thirty-five signatories of the AI Opportunity Statement received official warnings against joining this bloc.
These two groups are now actively setting the future of global AI standards.
Would you trust software built by a specific geopolitical bloc?
